label: Seniors
assignment: Discover realistic resources that help older adults in {service_area} remain safe, healthy, connected, and as independent as possible. Follow aging agencies and senior centers to specific meals, transportation, benefits, caregiver, in-home, health, legal, housing, and social programs. Verify age and functional criteria, cost, waitlists, service area, assessment, and enrollment.
include: Meals, transportation, senior centers, social connection, exercise, and technology help
Benefits counseling, Medicare, Medicaid, prescription, tax, financial, and legal assistance
In-home support, personal care, homemaking, home modification, fall prevention, and caregiver respite
Adult day services, dementia support, protective services, guardianship alternatives, and long-term-care navigation
Services for isolated, rural, disabled, low-income, veteran, immigrant, and kinship-caregiving older adults
exclude: Commercial senior-living marketing without a defined assistance or affordability pathway
General adult services that do not accommodate age, mobility, cognition, or caregiving realities
Programs whose waitlists, functional criteria, or service boundaries make local access unrealistic
